subject.title: fix(ios): connect iPhone and Watch to protocol v3 gateways

question: Should paired-Watch relay traffic gain a scoped protocol-v3 operator/chat path, or should this PR be narrowed to iPhone node compatibility only?
rationale: The existing operator session serves several v4-era features, so lowering its floor globally may create compatibility failures beyond the Watch relay; the permanent Apple session boundary requires owner intent.

options.title: Support the relay explicitly
options.body: Add a v3-compatible paired-Watch chat path with negotiated gating while preserving v4 requirements for unsupported operator features.

options.title: Narrow to node-only support
options.body: Remove the paired-Watch compatibility claim and changelog wording, land only the node handshake fix, and leave the linked issue open for Watch relay work.

recommendation.title: Support the relay explicitly
recommendation.body: Add a v3-compatible paired-Watch chat path with negotiated gating while preserving v4 requirements for unsupported operator features.

likelyOwner.reason: The current Apple node/operator architecture and this compatibility proposal are concentrated in the iOS and shared Swift surfaces associated with this contributor.
